result.summary: Found 2 visual issues. The most noticeable is a broken data value showing as “€NaN delivery”. There are also a few horizontally scrolling items that are visibly cut off at the right edge, which may look unfinished if not intentional.

issues.description: The delivery fee for “Smash Bros Burgers” displays as “€NaN delivery”, indicating a broken or missing numeric value being rendered to the user.
issues.suggestion: Add validation/fallback handling for missing or invalid delivery fee values, such as showing “Free delivery”, “Delivery fee unavailable”, or hiding the fee until a valid value is available.

issues.description: Several horizontal carousel items are cut off at the right edge, including the category pill after “Healthy” and the third restaurant card in “Fastest near you”. This may be intentional scrolling behavior, but visually it looks abrupt and unfinished.
issues.suggestion: If these are carousels, consider adding clearer scroll affordance, consistent card spacing, or a fade/peek treatment. If not intended, constrain the content to the viewport or reduce item widths.
